profile.description1: I am a graduate of a master's degree in computer science (with honors) at the Silesian University of Technology, specializing in data and systems engineering. I work as a software engineer (Full-Stack role) at Asseco Poland, delivering web and server features using TypeScript (Angular), Java (Spring / Spring Boot), and relational databases (PostgreSQL, Oracle).
profile.description2: My main interests include building reliable, containerized, and observable platforms—especially Kubernetes, cloud-native architectures, microservices, and data processing pipelines. I enjoy designing clear service boundaries, integrating communication gateways and APIs, and improving performance and maintainability through automation and good engineering practices.
profile.description3: I value a pragmatic approach to engineering: measuring before optimization, writing maintainable code, and collaborating in Agile / Scrum teams. Currently, I am expanding my knowledge in Kubernetes operations and advanced cloud platform patterns. I am always open to ambitious challenges at the intersection of software engineering, infrastructure, and data-intensive systems.
profile.description4: I strive to broaden my knowledge by participating in various trainings and certification exams to further deepen my continuous technological development.

education.engineerDescription: The field of study is intended for people interested in electronics and computer science who tie their future to them. Personally, I gained a lot of valuable information that allowed me to grow and encouraged me to learn new technologies in the field of computer science.
education.masterDescription:
The program is dedicated in particular to subjects that provide skills in data analysis and processing using tools based on various data models, artificial intelligence,
deep learning, and cloud resources and Big Data platforms. As part of this course, participants also learn about various cloud processing platforms and new paradigms
for creating scalable, extensible, and globally available software.
education.engineerProjectDescription: The project is an application for monitoring areas. The application architecture is based on a microservices architecture with inter-server communication via a message queue. The first server in the main service takes control of the client application. The second server manages sending emails. The system includes authentication and authorization based on data security. The web application's appearance is modern, based on interactive maps and reusable components. Responsiveness of elements is also ensured, so applications can be used on phones and tablets. The project was designed and implemented by me as part of my engineering thesis.
education.masterProject: DNA sequence identification in the basecalling process on edge Kubernetes clusters
education.masterProjectDescription: An experimental edge processing platform that uses multiple neural network models to identify DNA/RNA bases in a cluster of NVIDIA Jetson Nano devices. The project examines the feasibility, performance, energy efficiency, and automation of deploying nanopore signal (FAST5) → nucleotide sequence inference at the edge of the network instead of relying on centralized GPU servers.

professionalExperience.enteDescription:
I worked at ENTE Sp. z o.o. as a fullstack web developer, where my tasks
included maintaining existing applications and creating completely new projects for
clients. In addition to typical web applications, I also participated in creating
mobile applications. The technology I worked with:
JavaScript/TypeScript (Angular 12+), CSS (PrimeNG, Bootstrap), Java (Spring, Spring
Boot), ORM (JPA, Hibernate), relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL), non-relational
databases (MongoDB), data streaming (Apache Kafka), version control systems (GitHub,
GitLab), CI/CD (Jenkins, Groovy), containerization and hosting (Docker, Kubernetes),
mobile applications (Ionic). I participated in creating projects such as:
GPS system for vehicle monitoring (AWIA Vehicle), internal system for railway maintenance
across Poland (Absynth AWIA), mobile application for controlling substitute bus
transport for Silesian Railways, internal reporting system, OLIMP 2.0 application.
professionalExperience.assecoDescription:
I belong to a small SCRUM team responsible for creating and managing web applications
for the healthcare sector. The tech stack includes: TypeScript (Angular 14+), Java
11+ with Spring Boot, relational databases in ORACLE, version control system (Gitlab),
CI/CD (Jenkins, TeamCity).

projects.personalAgentAiDescription: A private AI agent based on an Ollama container with its own model configuration and input parameters.
projects.jetsonBasecalling: DNA sequence identification in the basecalling process on edge Kubernetes clusters
projects.jetsonBasecallingDescription: An experimental edge processing platform that deploys multiple DNA/RNA basecalling models based on neural networks in a cluster of NVIDIA Jetson Nano devices. The project examines feasibility, performance, energy efficiency, and automation of deploying nanopore nucleotide sequence inference (FAST5) at the network edge instead of relying on centralized GPU servers. K3s—a lightweight Kubernetes platform—significantly облегчает cluster infrastructure management and container orchestration.
projects.k3sOnJetsonNano: K3s cluster configuration with GPU on NVIDIA Jetson Nano devices
projects.k3sOnJetsonNanoDescription: A guide to a fully working K3s cluster configuration on NVIDIA Jetson Nano edge devices using GPU. The configuration includes a control device (master node) and worker nodes.
projects.areaMonitoringAppDescription: This is an application for controlling data from monitoring areas using Ultra Wideband technology. It is a web application with an Angular framework-based interface. The server-side of the application has been developed using Java Spring Boot with a microservices architecture, and all data is managed in a PostgreSQL database. All the message to user are sending by asynchronous message queue by Apache Kafka. This is my Engineering work, and I have personally written all the code.
projects.blockchainAnalysisDescription: The application extracts blockchain data from a public API, then transforms only the data needed for analysis and stores it in a Neo4j graph database. The application was created to carry out a project for anomaly detection in the blockchain network.
